parameters.content:
## 01 Form To CRM Enriched

Web form submission to a deduped, enriched, scored CRM record plus a Slack alert.

**Safety rails:** Calls 16-safety-rails before any outbound action.

**Before you enable this:** replace every REPLACE_WITH_* value, point CRM_BASE_URL/CRM_ADAPTER at your CRM, and run it once manually with test data.

Docs: README.md, docs/SETUP.md, docs/COMPLIANCE.md

nodes.name: Form Submitted
nodes.notes: Point your form (Webflow, WordPress, Typeform, plain HTML) at this production URL.

nodes.name: Safety Rails
nodes.notes: Calls 16-safety-rails. Nothing that can reach a prospect runs before the rails return allowed=true.

nodes.name: Rails Allowed?
nodes.notes: False branch is a dead end by design.

parameters.query:
=SELECT id, email, phone, name, company, domain, source, created_at
FROM leads
WHERE (NULLIF('{{ $json.match.email_key }}', '') IS NOT NULL AND email_key = '{{ $json.match.email_key }}')
   OR (NULLIF('{{ $json.match.phone_key }}', '') IS NOT NULL AND phone_key = '{{ $json.match.phone_key }}')
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Lookup Existing Lead
nodes.notes: Empty result is normal - it means this is a new lead.

nodes.name: Enrich Domain
nodes.notes: Provider-agnostic. Failure here must not lose the lead, so onError continues.

nodes.name: CRM Upsert
nodes.notes: One HTTP node, one mapping node. Swap CRM by changing CRM_BASE_URL, the credential and CRM_ADAPTER. See docs/CRM-MAPPING.md.
